description: This file defines an enumeration called FieldType which categorizes JSON fields into types like REGULAR, SPECIAL, and HIDDEN. It also provides predicates for filtering fields based on their type, used within a JSON handling context in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: FieldType
classes.description: An enum representing types of JSON fields with associated predicate logic to filter fields based on their type.

methods.name: notHidden
methods.description: Returns a predicate to filter JSON fields that are not hidden.

methods.name: regularOrSpecial
methods.description: Returns a predicate to filter JSON fields that are either regular or special.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a predicate that matches all JSON fields.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Implements the Predicate interface; tests if a given JsonField matches the FieldType.
